Calls FUN_00560FC0(cVar2) (which sends opcode 0x17 with the cVar2 byte via FUN_004D7980). If uVar3 != 0: calls FUN_00586F40(*(this+0x7c), uVar3 | 0x400). If gate *(this+0xbc) == 0 AND shadow *(this+0x94) == uVar3 (same-zone fast-return), returns. Otherwise calls FUN_00586F40(*(this+0x7c), 0x4FF), writes *(this+0xac) = uVar3, sets flag *(this+0xb9) = 1. Always sets flag *(this+0xba) = 1.
case_table.notes: Largest case (~50 lines). Two distinct state mutations + one c2s emit (FUN_00560FC0 sends opcode 0x17 acknowledging zone-init progress to the server). 0x4FF / 0x800 / 0x4FF magic values to FUN_00586F40 are likely state-machine event tags. BCS-Y-0562 named this 'case 0x05 zone init' - this manifest characterizes the body.

key_findings.title: Default case fallthrough to FUN_004D8860 - the pattern d subdispatcher pass's finding CONFIRMED
key_findings.summary: The pattern d subdispatcher pass noted (and named in BCS-Y-0562) that FUN_0059CED0's default branch forwards to FUN_004D8860. This is significant: FUN_004D8860 will receive the packet but its `this` context will be whatever the call-time `ecx` register holds, which on entry to FUN_0059CED0 is the MapLayoutElement instance. If FUN_004D8860 expects a LuaActorImpl as its `this`, there is an implicit type pun here, OR the MapLayoutElement and LuaActorImpl share a layout-compatible head.
